The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. E-S/Vig/SI/GeM GTC Compliance/2025 dated 03.07.2025) The OEM is advised to issue tender-specific authorization to only one firm for the particular item/product. (iv).
